claims.text: Conversion for Canadian signups on or after 2026-04-01 is 31.8% against 41.2% before, a difference of -9.4% (95% CI -14.5% to -4.3%) in an observational comparison.
The price test shows an effect of -0.0827 on conversion with a 95% CI from -0.169 to +0.00366, so the result is inconclusive.
The test has a design power of 0.07 at the pre-registered MDE, so it could not reliably detect a conversion loss of that size.
438 relevant feedback mentions say the premium price is too high.
337 relevant feedback mentions say premium is worth the price.
The price test found no harm to conversion from the higher price.

gaps.text: No financial evidence exists for the revenue effect of the price change.

sections.contradicting: The observational comparison shows lower conversion [[c1]]. Feedback mentions say the price is too high [[c4]].
sections.summary: The price test is inconclusive [[c2]]. The observational comparison for one country shows lower conversion after the change date [[c1]]. Customers disagree about the price [[c4]] [[c5]].

uncertainties.text: The price test is underpowered, so its confidence interval spans both a loss and a gain.
